items.sentence: Guess what happened to me today!
items.translation: 你猜我今天发生了什么！
explanations:
分享新闻的开场白。`Guess what` = 你猜怎么着。常见错误：
• "Guess **that** what" → what 引导从句，不加 that
• "Guessing what" → 祈使用动词原形 Guess
`happened to me` = 发生在我身上。happen 是不及物动词，接人用 happen to sb。

sentenceAudio.text: Guess what happened to me today!

items.sentence: To be honest, I didn't expect it to be so good.
items.translation: 说实话，我没料到会这么好。
explanations:
`To be honest` = 说实话（坦率开场）。常见错误：
• "To be **honesty**" → honest 是形容词，honesty 是名词
• "Honest" → 单独说太生硬，用 to be honest

`didn't expect it` = 没料到它。expect 后接不定式 it to be…。常见错误：
• "didn't **expected**" → didn't 后接原形 expect
`to be so good` = 会这么好。so 修饰形容词表程度。

sentenceAudio.text: To be honest, I didn't expect it to be so good.

items.sentence: You're not going to believe this.
explanations:
预告惊人消息的口语开场。`be going to` 表将来。常见错误：
• "You're not **go** to believe" → going to 结构：be + going to
• "You won't believe" → 同义，但 you're not going to 更口语
`believe this` = 相信这件事。this 指代即将讲述的消息。

sentenceAudio.text: You're not going to believe this.

items.sentence: I bet he's already left for work.
items.translation: 我打赌他已经去上班了。
explanations:
`I bet` = 我敢打赌/我肯定（口语）。常见错误：
• "I bet **on**" → 表断言不加 on
• "I'm bet" → bet 是动词不加 be

`leave for + 目的地` = 动身去……。常见错误：
• "leave to work" → 搭配 leave for
• "left to work" → 离开去某地用 for

sentenceAudio.text: I bet he's already left for work.

items.sentence: Who's that woman you were talking to?
items.translation: 跟你说话的那个女人是谁？
explanations:
`talk to sb` 是「跟某人说话」，用介词 to。常见错误：
• "Who **that** woman" → 缺 be 动词，应为 Who's
• "Who's that **women**" → 单数用 woman，复数才是 women
定语从句里介词 to 留在句尾：the woman (that) you were talking to。

sentenceAudio.text: Who's that woman you were talking to?

explanations:
`Why would I ...?` 用虚拟语气反问，暗含「我没理由需要」。常见错误：
• "Why **will** I need" → 反问用 would 更自然
• "Why would **me** need" → 主语用主格 I
这类 would 用于表达「假设/反问」，不是将来时。

items.sentence: I'm not gonna talk about Judy.
explanations:
`gonna` 是 going to 的口语缩略，用于非正式场合。常见错误：
• "I'm not **going talk**" → 口语 gonna 对应 going to + 动词原形
• "talk **with** Judy" → 谈及某事用 talk about
`talk about sth` 谈某事；`talk to sb` 跟某人说话。

sentenceAudio.text: I'm not gonna talk about Judy.

items.translation: 我觉着你有（你不承认而已）。
explanations:
`you do` 是替代式肯定，用 do 代指上文动词，起强调作用。常见错误：
• "I **thinking**" → 一般现在时用 think
• "you **does**" → 主语 you 配 do
这种 `do` 叫代动词（pro-verb），避免重复上文动词：I think you do = I think you do have it.

items.sentence: I was sitting next to her on the plane.
chunks: I was sitting next to her
explanations:
`next to` 是「在……旁边」的固定搭配。常见错误：
• "next **her**" → 必须带 to：next to her
• "I **were** sitting" → 主语 I 配 was
`on the plane` 指在飞机上；注意 train/bus 也用 on。
distractors: I was sat next to her
I were sitting next to her

sentenceAudio.text: I was sitting next to her on the plane.

items.sentence: I thought she said something to me.
explanations:
`say sth to sb` 是「对某人说某事」的固定搭配。常见错误：
• "say something **for** me" → 对某人说用 to
• "she **says** something" → 与主句时态一致，用过去式 said
注意 say 后面直接接内容，tell 需接人：say to me = tell me。
`I thought ...` 用过去时表示「我（原）以为」，常暗含事实上并非如此。

sentenceAudio.text: I thought she said something to me.

items.sentence: Yeah, maybe run into her at the gym.
items.translation: 也许能在健身房和她偶遇。
explanations:
`run into sb` 是「偶然遇到某人」的固定搭配。常见错误：
• "run **to** her" → 偶遇用 run into，不是 run to
• "maybe **running**" → maybe 后面接动词原形（省略了 I might）
对比 `run into`（偶遇）/ `bump into`（同义）/ `meet`（约见或相遇）。

sentenceAudio.text: Yeah, maybe run into her at the gym.
